yt_description:
Ever wondered how your favorite apps sort massive lists so FAST? 🤔 Meet Tim Sort, the hybrid sorting algorithm that's smarter than your average sort! 🧙‍♂️ We break down its magic, from insertion sort's efficiency on small chunks to merge sort's power on larger datasets. Get ready to have your mind BLOWN! 💥

✨ What you'll learn:
* How Tim Sort combines Insertion Sort and Merge Sort.
* The concept of 'runs' and how they're identified.
* Why Tim Sort is so efficient in real-world scenarios (especially with partially sorted data!).
* Visualizations that make complex algorithms EASY to understand.
